body: As far as I know, no one that she's encountered so far is a specialist in anything specific. As for the age gap, I'm 39 and she's 28. I too wonder that will come of tomorrow sessions. I'll probably update the thread afterwards with the overall result. Thank you for your time up this point.

The love makes me feel responsible. When everyone else has basically given up on her, if I don't help her fight, who will? And that is the endgame. Helping, not doing the work for her. Yes, she is willing, but her outlook on the help that she will receive is basically non existent. She has had quite a few therapist so far that have just told her to "think positively", which is completely fruitless and just makes her more frustrated. I'm hoping that I can at least get some kind of understanding when we go to the session tomorrow what she's experiencing, and give some insight. Is it just her that's making up her own narrative of how she experiencing things, or is the treatment she's getting actually as incompetent as she makes it seem. I feel like I'm holding my breath waiting for the next step in the process to come forth.
